answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in delta and dawn lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the wander graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 964 impostors cost 513 times the honest price and take 8 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
